name: Boo
appearance:
Boo is a small, fuzzy miniature giant space hamster (allegedly) who enjoys fruit and is Minsc's stalwart companion. He has a strong sense of justice, and is unafraid of confronting evil and taking matters into his own tiny hands. Boo is very observant, and never sleeps deeply when evil is near. He is patient and wise, serves as the brains to Minsc's brawn and is also Minsc's moral guide.

Boo is somewhat wary of cats, and has a soft spot for Shadowheart.

Despite his diminutive size, he is usually unable to activate or enter burrows and tiny holes in walls. As Minsc often says, "Boo would squeeze through but he just had a big lunch."
backstory:
Boo comes from a large family, having "many dozen cousins". He is the long time familiar and, quite possibly, greater half of Minsc ever since they met - when Minsc was just a typical Rashemi berserker. Minsc was ambushed and injured, and only just recovering when Boo appeared. Boo declared that Minsc had felt the "poking finger of justice", marking Minsc as its champion and Boo as his guide.

After the events of , both Boo and Minsc were ambushed by an unknown assailant and petrified in the middle of the marketplace in the Upper City in Baldur's Gate. They were released 80 years later, when Delina, a wild mage, accidentally struck the statue with a wild magic surge.

Minsc and Boo continued to travel together, but were separated for a time while Minsc was tricked into carrying out orders for the false Jaheira. Boo was trapped in a wall in the Lower City Sewers by Absolute cultists, who feared his righteous gaze.
